{{Infobox quest |image =Wiring the Vessel Banner.png |location =[[Icebreaker]] |given by =[[Peacekeeper]] |previous =[[Peaceful Atom]] |leads to = |related = |related2 = |reqkappa =No }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|It looks like you will have to return to the Icebreaker after all. The data from the nuclear power plant logbook was not sufficient. Our partners need real-time readings from the power unit, so I've purchased a special device from Mechanic for remote connection to the central control station. Before you install it, however, you must ensure that all equipment in the technical areas is functioning properly. Take tools with you and restore the circuit breakers that have been taken offline, then install this device in the control room. I have been informed that the damaged breakers are likely located in three areas. One is directly on the way to the engine room, near the locker rooms with coats. The second is directly beneath that section. The third is somewhere in the corridors running along the engine compartment. Once you have restored all breakers, return to the central control station. Install the device there and report back.}} ==Objectives== * Repair the equipment in the automation room leading to the engine room on [[Icebreaker]] * Repair the equipment in the automation room under the engine room on [[Icebreaker]] * Repair the equipment in the automation room near the storage room on [[Icebreaker]] * Install the [[Local network hacking device|hacking device]] in the central control station room on [[Icebreaker]] '''Note:''' The "Install" objective will appear after the "Repair" objectives are completed. ==Rewards== * +30,000 [[EXP]] * 5,400 Dollars ** 5,670 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 6,210 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * Unlocks barter for [[S I C C organizational pouch]] at [[Peacekeeper]] LL1 {{quote|It seems Mechanic’s device is functioning properly. I hope you managed to avoid contact with the special unit I warned you about. My recommendation remains the same: if you want to survive, it would be best not to return to that site.}} ==Initial Equipment== {|class="wikitable" !Icon !Item name !Amount |- |[[File:Local network hacking device icon.png|link=Local network hacking device]] |[[Local network hacking device]] |1 |} ==Guide== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !Find in raid !Notes |- ![[File:Toolsicon.png|link=Toolset]] |[[Toolset]] |1 |Required !N/A |This item is used for repairing the equipment.
